items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: Dinell Howard talks about playing with bands but I can't recall Oliver specifically.

ctx.x: Yes. My memory's a little dim on that but I seem to remember hearing him at Midway. He also played at the Plantation.

Did you ever play at the Midway Gardens? There were colored bands and I don't remember specifically Oliver. People like Cook's band played out of White City and possibly Midway and Dinell Howard talks about playing with bands but I can't recall Oliver specifically.
By 1926 at least everybody in the Oliver band or associated with it as far as we were concerned were legendary as being wonderful musicians.
